title: Fix config key drift and rename transaction rollback
summary: Reject desktop settings patches that introduce, edit, or remove unknown config keys while preserving preexisting unknown keys during unrelated saves; make rename rollback continue when undo-manifest writes fail during rollback; add config-key parity and rename edge-case coverage; preserve WebView rename-cleaning save feedback through catalog reload.
reason: Review found config-key drift risks, desktop/core ownership drift, unknown settings keys accepted through patch APIs, and rename rollback paths where rollback-started manifest failures could mask the original rename failure and prevent rollback.
behavior_before: Settings patch parsing could accept unknown keys or allow preexisting unknown keys to be edited; save evidence could omit preserved unknown compatibility keys; core config parsing still had desktop-facing drift risks; rename rollback manifest writes in the exception path could block rollback; WebView rename-cleaning save text could be overwritten by the backend catalog refresh.
behavior_after: Settings patch preview/save reject new, edited, and removed unknown keys while preserving loaded unknown keys on unrelated known-key saves; save calls carry the full merged config; config-key parity and ownership tests cover schema/desktop/WebView/core boundaries; rollback manifest writes in the rollback path are best-effort; WebView rename-cleaning save feedback survives catalog reload.
manual_validation: Combined rename-first unittest target was attempted after the separate green suites, but the workspace repeatedly reverted tests/python/desktop/test_application_facade_settings_patch.py to stale unknown-key expectations between commands; focused suites were rerun after restoring the file.
RED unittest target - failed as expected for rollback manifest failure, unknown settings key acceptance, and core desktop config_keys imports; bundled pytest unavailable.
mediapipeline.tools.dev.refresh_summaries --paths for this packet's touched files - passed (6 written, 5 unchanged).
rollback_plan: Revert the settings patch candidate/policy/save-facade changes, rename apply-runner rollback manifest best-effort change, WebView rename-cleaning save-message change, and the focused tests in this packet. This returns unknown-key settings patch handling, rename rollback manifest behavior, and WebView rename-cleaning feedback to the prior implementation.
notes: Bundled Python does not include pytest, so requested pytest invocations were run as equivalent unittest module targets with PYTHONPATH=src. The worktree had extensive unrelated dirty files and untracked change packets before this task; those were left untouched.
